name: command
title: Command
description: A searchable list of commands, inline or as a palette in a dialog.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import "../core/vitehub.css";
import "./command.css";
import { Command as CommandRoot } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandEmits, CommandProps, CommandSlots } from "./types.ts";

const query = defineModel<string>("query");
const { defaultQuery } = defineProps<CommandProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<CommandEmits>();
defineSlots<CommandSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <CommandRoot v-model:query="query" data-slot="command" :default-query="defaultQuery" @action="(value: string) => emit('action', { value })"><slot /></CommandRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandEmpty as CommandEmptyPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandEmptyProps, CommandEmptySlots } from "./types.ts";

const { label = "No results found." } = defineProps<CommandEmptyProps>();
defineSlots<CommandEmptySlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <CommandEmptyPart data-slot="command-empty"><slot>{{ label }}</slot></CommandEmptyPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandGroup as CommandGroupPart, CommandGroupLabel } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandGroupProps, CommandGroupSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { heading } = defineProps<CommandGroupProps>();
defineSlots<CommandGroupSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <CommandGroupPart data-slot="command-group">
    <CommandGroupLabel v-if="heading" data-slot="command-group-label">{{ heading }}</CommandGroupLabel>
    <slot />
  </CommandGroupPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandItem as CommandItemPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandItemProps, CommandItemSlots } from "./types.ts";

const { value, disabled = false, shortcut } = defineProps<CommandItemProps>();
defineSlots<CommandItemSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <CommandItemPart data-slot="command-item" :value="value" :disabled="disabled || undefined" :shortcut="shortcut"><slot /></CommandItemPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandList as CommandListPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandListSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<CommandListSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <CommandListPart data-slot="command-list"><slot /></CommandListPart>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandSeparator as CommandSeparatorPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
</script>

<template>
  <CommandSeparatorPart data-slot="command-separator" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { CommandShortcut as CommandShortcutPart } from "@ui-sdk/vue/command";
import type { CommandShortcutSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineSlots<CommandShortcutSlots>();
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Empty, it shows the item's `shortcut` in the keys of the platform. -->
  <CommandShortcutPart data-slot="command-shortcut"><slot /></CommandShortcutPart>
</template>
